summary: Frontend-only regression test for the two new plan features (Copy-to-Clipboard, Plan-Diff-on-Regenerate) and the previously-observed 'stuck on Loading…' bug on Master Plan / Delegation Plan pages. All 6 requested scenarios pass. Master Plan and Delegation Plan pages load cleanly (no stuck Loading), Regenerate triggers the plan-diff-dialog with a populated diff body, success toasts appear ('Master plan generated — 8 roadmap tasks' and delegation equivalent), Copy button toast fires without crash (clipboard blocked in automation as expected → app shows graceful 'Copy failed — clipboard blocked' toast, no exception), and the regression navigation (Dashboard → Master Plan → Delegation Plan) shows both pages re-render with generate buttons and NO 'Loading…' hang. The previously fixed bug is confirmed resolved.

issues: React a11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — add a DialogDescription or aria-describedby to /app/frontend/src/components/PlanDiffDialog.jsx for accessibility compliance (non-blocking).

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby in PlanDiffDialog.jsx to silence a11y warning.

(Optional) On Copy button click when clipboard API is unavailable, the toast currently reads 'Copy failed — clipboard blocked'. Consider a friendlier fallback (e.g., copy via textarea + document.execCommand) so headless/automation and insecure contexts still succeed.
critical_code_review_comments: MasterPlan.jsx / DelegationPlan.jsx load effect with cancel-guarded promise keyed on current?.id works — no Loading hang observed across multiple navigations and regenerates.

Backend replace_one upsert atomicity (no delete-then-insert null window) appears to fix the intermittent regenerate-hang scenario. Confirmed via UI: regenerating and immediately re-rendering the plan never left the page in a Loading state.
Diff dialog correctly reports '78 added / 127 removed' on first regenerate of the seeded hand-authored plan — matches the expected 'real (non-empty) diff on first regenerate' contract.
seed_data_creation: None — used auto-seeded 'Contractor Storage Yard Website' project.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Master Plan and Delegation Plan pages both stable. data-testids verified: nav-master-plan, nav-delegation-plan, copy-master-btn, export-master-btn, generate-master-btn, copy-delegation-btn, export-delegation-btn, generate-delegation-btn, materialize-btn, plan-diff-dialog, plan-diff-body all present and functional. plan-diff-empty was NOT triggered (first-regen produced a non-empty diff, which is expected). If a subsequent regenerate is done on an already-generated plan, plan-diff-empty path should activate — not tested here.
rca of the issue: N/A — previously reported 'stuck on Loading…' after Regenerate is now RESOLVED. Root cause per E1: backend generate endpoints previously used delete-then-insert creating a brief null window that could race with the frontend load effect; fix is replace_one upsert (atomic) plus a cancel-guarded frontend load effect keyed on current?.id. Verified end-to-end in this iteration.
